questions.explanation: Saponification is the process of making soap by heating fats or oils with concentrated sodium hydroxide. The ester links in the triglyceride are hydrolysed, producing glycerol and sodium salts of fatty acids (soap). Fat/Oil + NaOH -> Soap + Glycerol.
